name: edoc-Server. Open-Access-Publikationsserver der Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin
additional_information:
EthnOA_text sub-collection: 
https://edoc.hu-berlin.de/server/oai/request?verb=ListRecords&metadataPrefix=oai_dc&set=fidethnoa

EthnOA_text offers a publication platform for ethnological texts on the edoc-server of the Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin. The publications are made permanently available via DOI and are freely accessible worldwide in the spirit of Open Access.

Researchers can publish their work via EthnOA_text for the first time or exercise their secondary publication rights to make previously published works available under a free Creative Commons license.

EthnOA_text also supports researchers in social and cultural anthropology without an institutional affiliation and without access to an institutional repository.
